flashcard_questions.q: The legal responsibility for paying the debts of a business.
A situation where the business owner is personally responsible for all business debts, meaning personal assets such as a house or car could be seized.
A situation where business owners can only lose the amount they invested in the business, protecting their personal assets.

flashcard_questions.a: A business owned and run by one person who has full control over all decisions and keeps all the profits.
A type of business owned by two or more people who share responsibility, decision-making, and profits.
